rules.text: Bold, attention-seeking; romance, passion, feminine energy, love and lust; also anger and aggression

source.quote: the personality of red is one that is both bold, and attention seeking.

rules.say: You are bold and like to be noticed, with a lot of romance and passion in you. This colour is also linked with anger, so take care with your temper.

rules.text: Selective: picks what they want and enjoys it fully; gives time only to what they chose; can be bright or go unnoticed

source.quote: orange would be that person who picks and chooses what he or she wants, and then enjoys it to the fullest!

rules.say: You pick and choose what you want and then enjoy it to the fullest, giving your time only to what you have chosen. You can shine brightly or go quietly unnoticed.

rules.text: Authority that stays approachable; life, happiness, friendliness (colour of the sun); changes when mixed

source.quote: Yellow can be analyzed as the authoritative figure that is, despite his position of power, approachable.

rules.say: You carry authority yet stay approachable, like the sun: full of life, happiness and friendliness.

rules.text: Dual: growth, abundance, peace, love for others; too much brings suspicion, envy, doubt

source.quote: a mindset of growth, or abundance; while at the same time too much of it, makes represents the emotions of suspicion and envy.

rules.say: You have a mindset of growth, abundance and peace, with love for others. Too much of it can bring suspicion, envy and doubt, so keep a check on these.

rules.text: "Highest" colour: elevated mindset; observes and absorbs; can lead or follow; deep talk over gossip; seeks knowledge; productive; future-focused; gentle

source.quote: blue is what represents an elevated mindset.

rules.say: You have an elevated mindset: you observe and absorb, can lead or follow, prefer deep talk to gossip, seek knowledge and stay gentle, productive and focused on the future.

rules.text: Spiritual; immense farsightedness; great impact on others, but own inner life often a mess; neglects present and relationships

source.quote: their own internal lives are most often a mess.

rules.say: You are spiritual and very farsighted, with a great impact on others. Your own inner life can get messy, so take care not to neglect the present and your relationships.

rules.text: Influence: gets the job done through others; royalty, power

source.quote: will not like doing things personally, but will ensure that the job is done.

rules.say: You may not like doing things personally, but you make sure the job gets done through others. You carry a sense of royalty and power.

rules.text: Commands respect; sophistication, luxury; aspired to but kept at a distance; aloof, seems unapproachable (like judges)

source.quote: black represents the personality of someone who commands respect.

rules.say: You command respect and carry sophistication and luxury. People look up to you but keep a distance, as you can seem aloof and hard to approach.

rules.text: Accepts everything that comes, stops nothing (opposite of black, which builds a barrier)

source.quote: white accepts anything and everything that comes its way, without doing anything to stop it at all.

rules.say: You accept whatever comes your way, without trying to stop any of it.

rules.text: Ambivert: deep and reserved, also light and approachable; wants to say and do a lot but enjoys keeping to self

source.quote: grey exhibits the personality of an ambi-vert.

rules.say: You are an ambivert: deep and reserved, yet light and approachable. You want to say and do a lot, but also enjoy keeping to yourself.

rules.text: Playful; some of red's passion with white's quiet; imagination

rules.say: You are playful and imaginative, with some of red's passion softened by white's quietness.

rules.text: Authoritative but expressive; reserved with most, life of the party with their own kind (VIP-lounge type)
